proposed_statement_changes.reason: The original wording risks conflating strongly polynomial oracle-call complexity with polynomial bit complexity for exact rational-function arithmetic, and it calls the returned deficient set a certificate without specifying an independently verifiable optimality certificate. The replacement states exactly the proved oracle-model guarantee.

proposed.justification: The theorem turns exponentially many Hall inequalities into an executable exact oracle-model reduction with a named obstruction.
proposed.gap: Schrijver supplies oracle submodular minimization, but not the fortified quotient-rank construction or a bit-complexity bound for its rational-function arithmetic.
proposed.consumer: Sensitivity analyses over defended proxy subsets can report the precise support blocks responsible for route failure instead of only a failed matrix-rank check.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The narrowed claim requires the Hall-defect definition and the generic-rank formula directly; the revised dependency list declares that complete proof spine and removes the unused full-rank-frontier dependency.
